scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @aerotrack/server" "npm run dev -w @aerotrack/web"
scripts.start: npm run build -w @aerotrack/web && npm run start -w @aerotrack/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
